newsitem.title: CANADA: Ranger plans capital spending hike.
newsitem.headline: Ranger plans capital spending hike.

text.p: Ranger Oil Ltd said on Wednesday that it planned to increase its capital spending program in 1997 to US$190 million.
The oil and gas company said the money would be divided equally between exploration and development projects.

Ranger said US$83 million would be spent in the United Kingdom developing new oil fields and exploring appraisal wells in the North Sea. The company expected this investment to lead to a major increase in North Sea oil production in 1998.
